firsts.name: The Ground Drank
firsts.journal: Water reached ground that had never held it. The whole Nook seemed to breathe out.

firsts.name: Something Given Back
firsts.journal: The first sapling went into cleared ground. Taking and giving turned out to be the same motion.

firsts.name: Grown Tall
firsts.journal: A tree I planted stands taller than I do now.

firsts.name: A Way Through
firsts.journal: A path now runs where there was only undergrowth.

firsts.name: First Clearing
firsts.journal: The first tree came down slowly, and the light changed where it had stood.

firsts.name: Mark on New Ground
firsts.journal: The first made thing in this Nook. It is not wilderness anymore — not entirely.

firsts.name: A Name Spoken
firsts.journal: I gave a place a name, and the name stuck.

firsts.name: Two Became One
firsts.journal: Two Nooks touch now. Standing at the seam, I could not say where one ended.

firsts.name: Something Buried
firsts.journal: It tumbled out mid-fall and caught the light. The ground had been keeping it for me.

firsts.name: It Was Waiting
firsts.journal: The vines pulled back on their own. Whatever slept there had decided the place was alive enough.
